# CartGain

> AI-powered cart recovery and negotiation platform for e-commerce businesses.

## Overview
CartGain helps Shopify and e-commerce stores recover abandoned carts using AI-powered WhatsApp and Email campaigns, plus an AI negotiator that converts price-sensitive shoppers without cutting below your margin floor.

## Key Features
- AI Cart Recovery (WhatsApp + Email multi-channel)
- AI Price Negotiation Widget
- Smart targeting and automation
- Revenue tracking and analytics
- Built for Shopify stores
